title: Topology in One Point Interaction Problem on Extended Non-Local Star Graphs and its Eigenvalues
summary: The author studies the inverse spectral problem of Sturm-Liouville operator on a star-like metric graph. At the vertex of this star-like graph, there are attached $m$ edges that imposed with non-local Sturm-Liouville operator satisfying some suitable non-local boundary conditions. At the vertex, we consider one point interaction condition to model a metric graph that fixed on the end of edges of the graph.
